import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Vector as V

doc = App.newDocument("Hook")

# Spreadsheet with named sizes
ss = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet", "Params")
vals = [("plate_height",60),("width",20),("thickness",5),("hook_depth",25),("lip_height",10)]
for i,(n,v) in enumerate(vals, start=1):
    ss.set(f"A{i}", n)
    ss.set(f"B{i}", f"{v} mm")
    ss.setAlias(f"B{i}", n)
doc.recompute()

# Sketch on XZ plane
sk = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Outline")
sk.Support = (doc.getObject("XZ_Plane"), [""])
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
doc.recompute()

pts = [(0,0),(25,0),(25,10),(20,10),(20,5),(5,5),(5,60),(0,60)]
n = len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    a = pts[i]; b = pts[(i+1)%n]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)), False)
for i in range(n):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1)%n, 1))
doc.recompute()

# Dimensional constraints driven by spreadsheet expressions
def dist_x(i, expr, name):
    c = sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceX", i, 1, i, 2, 1.0))
    sk.renameConstraint(c, name); sk.setExpression(f"Constraints.{name}", expr)
def dist_y(i, expr, name):
    c = sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", i, 1, i, 2, 1.0))
    sk.renameConstraint(c, name); sk.setExpression(f"Constraints.{name}", expr)

# Fix origin point
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 0, 1, -1, 1))

for i,t in hv.items():
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal" if t=="H" else "Vertical", i))
doc.recompute()

import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Vector as V

if "Hook" in App.listDocuments():
    App.closeDocument("Hook")
doc = App.newDocument("Hook")

ss = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet", "Params")
for i,(n,v) in enumerate([("plate_height",60),("width",20),("thickness",5),("hook_depth",25),("lip_height",10)], start=1):
    ss.set(f"A{i}", n)
    ss.set(f"B{i}", f"{v} mm")
    ss.setAlias(f"B{i}", n)
doc.recompute()

body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
xz = [o for o in body.Origin.OutList if o.Role == "XZ_Plane"][0]
sk = body.newObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Outline")
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xz, "")]
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
doc.recompute()

pts = [(0,0),(25,0),(25,10),(20,10),(20,5),(5,5),(5,60),(0,60)]
n = len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[(i+1)%n]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)), False)
for i in range(n):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1)%n, 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 0, 1, -1, 1))
for i in range(7):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal" if i%2==0 else "Vertical", i))

def dim(i, axis, expr, name):
    c = sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance"+axis, i, 1, i, 2, 1.0))
    sk.renameConstraint(c, name)
    sk.setExpression(f"Constraints.{name}", expr)

dim(0,"X","Params.hook_depth","right")
dim(1,"Y","Params.lip_height","up_lip")
dim(2,"X","-Params.thickness","left_lip")
dim(3,"Y","-(Params.lip_height - Params.thickness)","down")
dim(4,"X","-(Params.hook_depth - 2 * Params.thickness)","left_base")
dim(5,"Y","Params.plate_height - Params.thickness","up_plate")
dim(6,"X","-Params.thickness","left_top")
doc.recompute()

pad = body.newObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Extrude")
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Type = 0
pad.setExpression("Length", "Params.width")
doc.recompute()

print("sketch solve:", sk.solve(), "DoF-ish; verts:", [(round(p.x,3),round(p.y,3)) for p in [g.StartPoint for g in sk.Geometry]])
s = pad.Shape
print("valid", s.isValid(), "vol", s.Volume, "bbox", s.BoundBox)
